blurb: Guests can participate in free public kayaking at Pier 26 on the Hudson River Park. The organization also runs kayaking demo-days at various locations in the tri-state area and hosts organized kayaking events for local schools and non-profit groups. The Boathouse is an all-volunteer organization supporting community outreach and safe boating.
